card.name: The digit 8 in years and zip codes
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 8 inside a number, such as the third digit of a 1980s year (19-8-3) or of a Maryland zip code (20-8-52). It also fires weakly on a few words in citation titles and on 'differ' in age comparisons.

modes.label: Digit 8 in 1980s years
modes.description: The 8 after '19' in a year of the 1980s, in a citation or history sentence.
modes.example: In 19<<8>>5, the Journal of Dental Research published

modes.label: Digit 8 in zip codes and report numbers
modes.description: The 8 in a Maryland zip code starting 208 or in a report number.

modes.label: Words in citation titles
modes.description: The 'a' or colon in a reference title such as 'Alcohol and breast cancer in women: a pooled analysis'.
modes.example: Alcohol and breast cancer in women:<< a>> pooled analysis of cohort studies.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens and a plain output effect; they look like unrelated fragments and survey words.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit 8 inside years like 1985 and zip codes like 20852.
